Module com.example.miniproyecto_50zo
Package com.example.miniproyecto_50zo.model.interfaces

Interface GameObserver

All Known Implementing Classes:
GameController
public interface GameObserver
Observer interface for reacting to game state changes in the Cincuentazo game. Implements the Observer design pattern to decouple the GameModel from the controller and view layers. The GameModel notifies all registered observers whenever a significant game event occurs.
